decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (PC-11-050/02A; PC-11-050/LP01A) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The existing timber 'sleeper' edging to the car park and parking areas shall be retained and kept in good condition

Condition : 4 - The existing hedge boundaries between the site and Lampton Park and No 84 Lampton Road shall be retained and, where the hedge has developed gaps, restored and replanted in the next available planting season following the date of this permission.
Condition : 5 - The car park barrier control box housing and the car park barrier shall be painted in a predominantly dark green colour within three months of the date of this permission
description: Resurfacing of Lampton Park Conference Centre over spill car park
